name: Westfield Topanga
summary: Westfield Promenade serves as a comprehensive shopping and entertainment hub in Woodland Hills, offering a curated mix of international and local retailers alongside diverse dining options. As part of the global Westfield portfolio spanning 12 countries, this center delivers on-trend fashion, entertainment events, and modern conveniences designed to enhance the customer experience.
demographics: Westfield Promenade primarily serves the affluent San Fernando Valley community of Woodland Hills and surrounding West Valley neighborhoods, attracting middle to upper-middle-income families and professionals with household incomes typically ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The trade area draws a diverse demographic mix including young professionals, established families with children, and active retirees who value convenience and quality. Shoppers at this location tend to favor a balance of mainstream national retailers and specialty brands, with frequent visits for both planned shopping trips and casual dining experiences.
description: Westfield Promenade is a premier shopping destination in Woodland Hills featuring global brands like Nike, Sephora, Uniqlo, and Starbucks. The center offers a dynamic entertainment experience that combines retail, dining, and leisure in one convenient location. With time-saving amenities like click-and-collect services and Smart Parking, Westfield Promenade provides both quick shopping trips and all-day experiences.
